project: Knowledge-Grounded Zero-Shot Defect Inspection for Earthen Heritage Architecture

defect_classes.name: Structural Crack
defect_classes.description: Linear separation or fracture appearing on earthen mudbrick surfaces, caused by structural settling, seismic stress, or thermal expansion. Characterized by sharp high-contrast dark lines.
defect_classes.prompt_template: An earthen mudbrick wall showing a prominent structural crack fracture with sharp linear boundary.

defect_classes.name: Surface Erosion
defect_classes.description: Loss of surface plaster or clay binding material caused by wind, rain wash, or weathering. Results in rough, pitted texture and exposed inner mudbrick layers.
defect_classes.prompt_template: An earthen architectural wall exhibiting surface erosion, pitted texture, and degraded plaster binding.

defect_classes.name: Moisture Stain & Efflorescence
defect_classes.description: Dark damp patches or white salt crust deposits (efflorescence) caused by moisture capillary rise or rainwater infiltration into porous rammed earth.
defect_classes.prompt_template: A damp earthen wall showing dark water discoloration and white salt efflorescence staining.
